title: Welcome! 👋
body: Hi, I'm Philip, and I started building software with Ruby on Rails at a New York City startup in 2007. I have more than 18 years of software engineering experience and 8 years as a manager and lead engineer, growing from developer to senior developer, lead developer, and senior engineering manager for a worldwide remote team of 12.

Today I use Claude Code to build AI-powered software as a lead software engineer at Olio Apps in Portland, Oregon, where I ship BlackLine's new AI Account Recs 3.0 product and the Daily Reading app for the Grace and Mercy Foundation. Outside work, I walk my dog, play live poker at Portland Meadows, and vlog on YouTube; I also care about making computers accessible to people with disabilities, and I am optimistic about the future :-)

title: Phil's Career
body: I started in tech as an analyst at Brightidea in 2007, when I was 25 and moving from mathematics and education into software. I taught myself Ruby on Rails, joined readMedia a year later as its first full-time developer, and helped grow the company into what is now Merit.

Today I use Claude Code to build AI-powered software as a lead software engineer at Olio Apps in Portland, Oregon, where I ship BlackLine's new AI Account Recs 3.0 product and the Daily Reading app for the Grace and Mercy Foundation while following my passion for hiring great teams to build great products with great technologies.

title: Phil's Education
body: I majored in mathematics in college and grad school, and my first career was as a teacher in New York City.
However, I always loved computers and quickly transitioned to my new career as a developer.

title: Phil's App Store
body: I often program for fun, and you can browse my side projects on GitHub.
I once wrote a Ruby script to nab myself tickets to The Daily Show, which was first-come-first-serve on its website at the time, and you never knew when tickets would become available.

title: Phil's Hobbies
body: I maintain a healthy work/life balance.
If you'd like to learn more about me beyond my professional life, check out the links below!
